title: Balochistan Suppression of Prostitution Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Suppression of Prostitution Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 2001
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
SUPPRESSION OF PROSTITUTION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Balochistan
Suppression of
Prostitution Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
30th October, 2001]
No, Legis.2‑42/Law/79/IV,
dated 30‑10‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Balochistan Suppression of Prostitution (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force on
the 14th day of August, 2001.
